_comment: Checked-baggage allowances for Indian carriers, economy cabin, DOMESTIC sectors. fli/Google Flights does NOT return baggage weight, so we join on airline IATA code. Verified Aug 2026 against public airline baggage pages - re-verify before booking, airlines change these.

default_domestic.note: Fallback for any Indian carrier not listed

6E.name: IndiGo
6E.note: 'IndiGo Lite' / cabin-only fares carry 0 kg checked. Google Flights labels these Basic Economy - use exclude_basic_economy=true to drop them.

AI.name: Air India
AI.note: 25 kg on standard domestic economy - the most generous mainline allowance. Comfort/Flex fares higher.
